hooks.name: Re-check global steering on session start

action.prompt: This session may be a resume of an older session (I typically start Kiro with `kiro .`, which drops me back into an existing session that can be many days stale). Before acting on my first request, re-read every `.md` file in my global steering directory at `\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\rob\.kiro\steering\`, and also the workspace `.kiro/steering/` files. Compare them against what is already in context. If nothing changed, proceed silently. If anything changed, adopt the updated directives for the rest of the session and mention a change only if it affects what we are actively doing. Do not announce that you performed this check when nothing changed.
